title: Graceful shutdown's final full-store write holds StateInner for 649 ms under modeled load
outcome: Reduce or explicitly resolve the StateInner hold of the existing final full-store shutdown persistence while preserving shutdown durability and the transition to synchronous fallback.
acceptance: The existing final synchronous shutdown persistence preserves all mutations accepted before worker join completes, keeps persist_worker_alive ordering intact, and does not introduce a second concurrent persistence owner.

A disposable regression attributes the shutdown hold separately from active workload phases and verifies the chosen bounded-lock repair or documented resolution; the required review pair and full gate pass on the final input.
